headline: Mountain long run done — 816m D+ delivered, no knee issue, RPE ran hot
summary:
Solid execution: 2h26 out, 816m D+ (vs ~600m prescribed), avg HR 149 sitting right in the Z2 145-155 target band, and the interval summary shows a real sustained climb block around 153-157bpm plus a finishing push near 160. No knee pain reported — descents were run as planned. The catch is RPE 8 / feel "1" (bad) against a session that was meant to be aerobic bulk with one controlled 15min climb; that combined with 816m vs the ~600m called for suggests the climb and/or descent pace ran harder than intended, not just the terrain being steeper than mapped. icu load logged at 137, but per the known load-model gap this likely undercounts a high-intensity trail session by ~20-25%, so treat RPE 8 as the real signal, not the 137.</summary>

suggestedChange: Consider an easier Sunday (11 Oct) than currently planned — swap any remaining intensity for pure Z1-Z2 given today's RPE/feel mismatch, and confirm with Alberto whether the climb duration was followed before adjusting anything in Wk5.
